name: Cmstp.exe
description: Installs or removes a Connection Manager service profile.
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Silently installs a specially formatted local .INF without creating a desktop icon. The .INF file contains a UnRegisterOCXSection section which executes a .SCT file using scrobj.dll.
commands.usecase: Execute code hidden within an inf file. Download and run scriptlets from internet.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Silently installs a specially formatted remote .INF without creating a desktop icon. The .INF file contains a UnRegisterOCXSection section which executes a .SCT file using scrobj.dll.
commands.usecase: Execute code hidden within an inf file. Execute code directly from Internet.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10

detection: Execution of cmstp.exe without a VPN use case is suspicious
DotNet CLR libraries loaded into cmstp.exe
